basis: Frozen NOMAD PSX identity master. Current identity is based only on official-current evidence captured before the master was frozen. Live/delayed price feeds do not define identity or recommendation eligibility.

policy.coreRecommendationUniverse: Verified current Main Board ordinary equities. Dynamic market-status and risk/liquidity guardrails are applied at runtime.
policy.gemUniverse: Verified current GEM ordinary equities are held in a separate higher-risk universe and are disabled by default.
policy.alternativeUniverse: Current REIT, Modaraba, fund, rights, preference, SPAC and other special securities remain researchable but require separate frameworks.
policy.reviewRequired: Unverified/stale/historical-looking feed symbols are quarantined and never enter recommendations until a future master refresh verifies them.
policy.dynamicStatus: Transient live status codes such as XD/XB/XR/NC are not frozen into the master; the current market feed supplies them at runtime.
